div.head: Episc 7
div.ab: A he sceal scyldan Cristenum mannum wið ælc þæra þinga þe synlic bið; ⁊ þy he sceal on æghwæt hine þe swyðor teon, þæt he þe geornor wite, hu seo heord fare, þe he to Godes handa gehealdan sceall, þæt deofol to swyðe þæron na sceaþige, ne his falses to fela ongemang ne gesawe.

Semper debet Christianis preuidere contra omnia quę peccati sunt; et ideo debet se magis de pluribus intromittere, ut melius sciat, quomodo grex agat, quem ad Dei manum debet custodire (cu. suscepit), ne diabolus eum dilaniet, nec falsum suum (malum aliquod) superseminet.

A he sceal scyldan Cristenum mannum wið ælc þæra þinga þe synlic bið; and þy he sceal on æghwæt hine þe swyðor teon, þæt he þe geornor wite hu seo heord fare þe he to Godes handa gehealdan sceall, þæt deofol to swyðe þæron na sceaþige, ne his falses to fela ongemang ne gesawe.

Immer soll er Christenmenschen schützen gegen jedes der Dinge, die sündlich sind; und darum muss er in jegliches sich um so stärker einlassen, damit er um so eindringlicher wisse, wie die Herde fährt [lebt], die er zu Gunsten [im Auftrage] Gottes bewahren soll, damit darin der Teufel nicht zu sehr schade, noch dazwischen zu viel seines Truges säe.

He shall always protect Christian people against everything that is sinful; and therefore he must involve himself all the more in everything, so that he may know the more closely how the flock fares [lives] which he must keep on God's behalf, lest the devil do too much harm in it or sow too much of his falsehood among it.

He must always shield Christians against each of those things which are sinful; and thus he must devote himself the more deeply in all matters so that he might know the more truly how the flock fares which he must tend on God’s behalf, so that the devil may not inflict harm too greatly on them nor sow too much of his falseness among them.
div.note: sow too much of his falseness: See Matthew 13:39.
